description: This Rust source file implements a command-line tool `append_squashfs_overlay` that merges a squashfs image with an overlay image, creating a new combined image. It includes functions for aligning sizes, merging filesystem images, and command-line argument parsing, along with a test for argument validation.
external_files: std::io::{copy, Error, ErrorKind, Read, Result, Seek, SeekFrom}

methods.name: align_size
methods.description: Aligns a size to the specified power-of-two alignment.

methods.name: merge_fs
methods.description: Merges a source squashfs image with an overlay image into a destination file, optionally overwriting existing files.

methods.name: clap_command
methods.description: Defines and returns the command-line argument parser for the tool.
